description:
Goal
Add the request-local PullSession used by the product path to remember what one front-door demand has actually pulled.

Required shape
- Session-owned memo/in-progress guard for ProductKey results.
- Demanded executable set populated only when products are pulled by local dependencies.
- Symbolic call edge inventory keyed by ExecutableKey.
- Request-local incoming-input reverse index keyed by callee executable and semantic input slot.
- Transport component and final packaging inventory needed by later product producers.
- Telemetry counters for root_scans and follow_ups that must stay zero on the product path.

Signal
A session test proves a caller product records an outgoing edge and the callee input slot reads that exact key. No root executable frontier, fact-table scan, or full executable collection iteration is used to discover the callee.

Removal target
No production dependency on root_executable_frontier in the new path. If compatibility helpers remain reachable only from legacy jobs, document that boundary in the test names.

Verification
cargo fmt --all; targeted PullSession tests; rg coverage proving new PullSession code does not call root_executable_frontier.
title: Pull path: add request-local PullSession inventory
